delivery.outcome: Resolve Planfile discovery from paths below .planfile to the owning repository root and reject explicit nested-store construction before writes.
nonGoals: No migration or deletion of existing nested stores
No changes to ticket synchronization or external integrations
No rewrite of existing project configuration

architecture.decision: Centralize root-path handling in a small pure helper. Auto-discovery anchors at the outermost .planfile ancestor; direct store construction rejects any path inside .planfile. Existing nested directories remain untouched.
interfaceChanges: Planfile/PlanfileStore now reject explicit project paths inside .planfile
architecture.rollback: Revert the helper and guard; no persisted files are changed by this ticket.

commands: ruff check planfile/project_paths.py planfile/__init__.py planfile/core/store.py tests/test_project_paths.py
validation.evidence: Focused path-discovery regression, Ruff and governance outputs retained in the PR receipt.
